tools.name: jobs
tools.description: List extraction jobs with optional filters. Filter by job ID, URL, status (pending, running, completed, failed), output format, or date range. Results are paginated; use 'page' and 'page_size' to navigate large result sets. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Start an asynchronous batch extraction job from an explicit list of URLs. tools.name: batch_status
tools.description: Retrieve the status and paginated results of a batch extraction job by its job ID. Returns item counts, invalid URLs, and the current page of per-URL extraction results. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: cancel_batch
tools.description: Cancel a batch job by its job ID. Stops scheduling new batch items while allowing in-flight child extractions to drain. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: crawl

tools.name: cancel_crawl
tools.description: Cancel a crawl job by its job ID. Stops scheduling new crawl pages while allowing in-flight page work to drain. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: map

tools.name: map_jobs
tools.description: List map jobs for the authenticated user with optional filters. Filter by base URL (partial match), status (pending, running, completed, failed), or date range. Results are paginated; use 'page' and 'page_size' to navigate. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: map_job
tools.description: Retrieve the full details and discovered links for a map job by its job ID. Returns the current status and, once completed, the discovered links and their source. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: List search jobs for the authenticated user with optional filters. Filter by query (partial match), status (pending, running, completed, failed), or date range. Results are paginated; use 'page' and 'page_size' to navigate. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, jobs, batch, batch_status, crawl, map, map_jobs · Private data: extract, job, jobs, statistics, batch, batch_status, cancel_batch, crawl, crawl_status, cancel_crawl, map, map_jobs, map_job, search, search_jobs, search_job · Public sink: extract, batch, crawl · Destructive: extract, jobs, search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, jobs, batch, batch_status, crawl, map, map_jobs · Private data: extract, job, jobs, statistics, batch, batch_status, cancel_batch, crawl, crawl_status, cancel_crawl, map, map_jobs, map_job, search, search_jobs, search_job · Public sink: extract, batch, crawl · Destructive: extract, jobs, search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
